name: Contact Physics
author: Kizi
description: Cars react to hits like real ones: the AI holds its steering for a moment and spins from the hit. Softening off, wheel-to-wheel push on. Experimental.

options.label: Contact: AI reaction time
options.description: After a hit, the AI car's steering is held where it was for this long (0.2, 0.4 or 0.6 s) before the AI reacts, so the hit can turn the car.

options.label: Contact: AI spin from hits
options.description: Adds the yaw a real hit would give an AI car, worked out from where the cars touched and how fast they closed. Light, Medium or Strong.

options.label: Contact: twitch when hit
options.description: Gives every AI car in a contact at least a small yaw twitch. Needs "AI spin from hits" on.

options.label: Contact: applies to
options.description: Which contacts get the reaction time and the spin: all of them (AI against AI too), or only contacts with you.

options.label: Contact: who spins
options.description: Which car of a touching pair gets the extra spin: both, only the car behind (the one that hit), or only the car ahead (the one that was hit).

options.label: Contact: rear hit spins the car ahead
options.description: When the car ahead is hit behind its centre (a hit on the rear tyre), it gets at least this much spin, so a punt from behind can send it round.

options.label: Contact: wheel-over-wheel lift
options.description: When a tyre rides up on another car, the car behind is lifted at the wheel that touched (a rear-wheel touch lifts the rear). Experimental; separate from the wheel push.

options.label: Contact: tyre punctures
options.description: A hit at a tyre can give it a puncture, the more likely the harder the touch (touches under 10 km/h never do, full chance from 60 km/h). Uses the game's own puncture, so the tyre loses air and may burst.

options.label: Contact: punctures can hit you
options.description: Off = only AI cars get punctures from contact. On = your tyres too.

options.label: Contact: softening
options.description: The game softens every car-to-car hit with two assists. Off = hits are not softened. Ctrl+F9 switches it during a race.

options.label: Contact: wheel-to-wheel push
options.description: Touching tyres push the cars apart. The game ships this off. Levels from Subtle to Extreme; Extreme can throw cars. Ctrl+F10 cycles it during a race.

options.label: On-screen messages
options.description: Shows on-screen messages in the game's race notification.

options.label: Testing: log contacts
options.description: Writes every car-to-car touch to swofty\loader.log (who touched, how hard, how far each car turned). Only for testing; leave off.
